script.problem: Moment 2's passage John 19:18-22 doesn't include a verse that names Golgotha in the lessons.

terra.problem: “Carrying the cross to Golgotha” happens on the way there, not at Golgotha. Also, John 19:16–17 does not mention Simon; Mark 15:21–22 does.
John 19:18–22 calls the men crucified with Jesus “two others,” not robbers. Mark 15:27 identifies them as robbers.
